question: In which of the following Vedas was Dasarajna war (the war of ten kings) mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rigveda.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dasarajna war **(the war of ten kings) was mentioned in the **Rigveda.**
 
• This war was fought between the **Puru and Bharata tribes** and was one of the earliest recorded conflicts in ancient India.
 
• The Rigveda describes the **battle in detail, **including the names of the ten kings and the strategies they used.
 
• **The outcome of the war was in favor of the **Bharata **tribe, and their leader Sudas emerged victorious.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Rigveda** is the oldest and most important of the four Vedas in ancient Indian literature.

 
 
• **It offers a wealth of information about the beginnings of the world, the significance of the Gods, and practical tips for leading a happy and prosperous life.**
 
 
 
• The **Yajurveda **contains hymns and rituals related to **sacrificial ceremonies.**
 
 
• **​This text offers details about the Aryan people's social and religious lives.**
 
 
 
• The **Samaveda** focuses on melodies and chants** **used in religious ceremonies.
 
 
• **The Samaveda is divided into two sections: Part I consists of songs named Gana and Part II consists of a book of three poems called Archika.**
 
 
 
• The **Atharvaveda **contains** **spells and incantations for various purposes, including healing and protection.
 
 
• **The twenty Kandas that make up the Atharva Veda are further divided into thirty-six Prapathakas.**
